title: Likely bug in sending duration for profileSwitch, mongodb has different duration value
symptom: When extracting data from MongoDB for Profile Switch events, the duration field is incorrectly represented in milliseconds with a dual conversion from minutes to milliseconds (60*1000 * 60*1000), resulting in values like 2592000000000 which equals 720 minutes when divided by that factor. The issue may be related to profiles not switching off.
cause: The thread does not explicitly identify the root cause, but the issue reporter suspects a dual conversion bug in the code.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit referenced in the thread: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/9b90eea7740e86d8e614ce3b6b98a912348e2668
